title: English Practice Quiz 0999
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Before forwarding a message to a work group, you should ___.
options: check that it is accurate and relevant
questions.explanation: Checking accuracy and relevance helps prevent misinformation.

questions.question: The files ___ uploaded before the deadline.
questions.explanation: Files is plural, so the passive past form is were uploaded.

questions.question: A 'backup' copy is kept to ___.
options: replace the original if it is lost
questions.explanation: A backup helps restore information if the original is lost or damaged.

questions.question: A message asks you to share your password to avoid account closure. What should you do?
options: Do not share it; verify the message through an official channel
questions.explanation: Legitimate support should not ask you to disclose your password in a message.

questions.question: Please let me know if you ___ any difficulty.
questions.explanation: The subject you takes the base verb face in this conditional clause.

questions.question: To 'verify' information means to ___.
questions.explanation: Verify means confirm accuracy or truth.

questions.question: If your microphone is causing noise, you should ___.
options: leave the camera on and shout
questions.explanation: Muting when not speaking reduces background noise.

questions.question: The message was sent ___ mistake.
questions.explanation: The fixed expression is by mistake.

questions.question: A 'link' on a webpage is used to ___.
options: connect to another page or resource
questions.explanation: A link takes the user to another page, file or online resource.

questions.question: Which information should never be posted publicly without a valid reason and permission?
questions.explanation: Passwords are private security credentials and must not be shared publicly.
